content.title: Erie County students and families celebrate ahead of Earth Day | News 4 Buffalo
content.text: Skip to content by: Mark Ludwiczak Posted: Apr 20, 2026 / 10:44 PM EDT Updated: Apr 20, 2026 / 10:48 PM EDT SHARE BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) — Ahead of Earth Day on Wednesday, the WNY community came together to celebrate and help the next generation learn how to protect the environment. Erie County’s Earth Day celebration took place on Monday at the Northland Workforce Training Center, bringing together students, families and local organizations. The free event featured hands-on activities, crafts, and resources focused on environmental awareness. “It’s important to get young kids involved to first understand environmental issues, to work with their fellow students, their fellow classmates, and learn about the issues that matter the most,” Deputy Erie County Executive Lisa Chimera said.
